cues.en: As I mentioned in the previous video, doing interventional or causal mechanistic interpretability research is simultaneously easy and difficult.
cues.zh: 上一支影片提過，干預式或因果機制可解釋性研究，同時容易也困難。

cues.en: The coding part is easy, as you've now seen in this video.
cues.zh: 程式部分很容易，這支影片已經看到了。

cues.en: There are a few additional considerations and some tricks and other things to know about when coding
cues.zh: 撰寫前向傳播操作程式時，還有一些額外考量、技巧和其他要知道的事，

cues.en: forward pass manipulations, but that's relatively easy compared to all of the amazing things that you've learned so far in this course.
cues.zh: 但與這門課目前學過的各種精彩內容相比，那相對容易。

cues.en: That said, one tricky thing about writing these kinds of hooks is that you cannot interact with the functions or the data in the middle of a forward pass.
cues.zh: 不過，寫這類 hook 的一個難點，是前向傳播進行到一半時，無法與函數或資料互動。

cues.en: So I definitely recommend incorporating print statements into your hooks while you are first writing
cues.zh: 所以，剛開始寫程式時，我非常建議在 hook 中加入 print，

cues.en: your code and doing lots of sanity checking about matrix sizes and the hooked values.
cues.zh: 多多檢查矩陣大小與掛接到的值是否合理。

cues.en: Even if you're not planning on replacing the actual activations with zeros, it's still a good idea
cues.zh: 即使不打算真的把活化替換成零，

cues.en: to actually replace with zeros when writing your code initially, just to make it easier to check that your code is doing what you want it to do, where you want it to be doing it.
cues.zh: 一開始寫程式時，仍然可以先替換成零，這樣更容易確認程式碼是否在指定位置，做了你想做的事。
